_what: Why the M4 exploration schedule had to move from rounds (E07) to environment steps (E09).
_source: runs/m4_pilot_20260827, E07, two throwaway seeds, stopped early once the finding was established.
_method: round_end records from the training jobs; updates_this_round equals act_steps by the P0 invariant.
finding: E07 holds epsilon at 1.00 for rounds 1-100 and anneals over rounds 101-1000. Random play ends a loot-crate round in about 10 steps, so the hold collected roughly 950 of the 10,000 transitions min_size requires and the first gradient step landed near round 826, with epsilon already at about 0.11. A round is not a unit of experience: its length varies about 20x within one run. E09 counts hold and anneal in environment steps, the same unit as replay.min_size and replay.capacity.
